newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica shares reach new high.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica shares reach new high.

text.p: Shares in Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana rose to a new peak on Monday, as the sale of the group's final state stake of 21 percent was launched.

At 1025 GMT, shares in the group had reached a new all-time peak, rising 65 pesetas or 1.95 percent, to 3,405 pesetas a share. The shares outpaced the market with the IBEX index of 35 shares up 53.12 points, or 1.01 percent, to 5524.89.
"The share continues to be very strong and there is no pre-determined reference to tell you where it could stop," a Madrid broker said.
Telefonica shares rose 80 percent in value last year, and now cost more than twice what they did at the last public share offer in 1995.

The price is already above the range of forecasts for the final price of the shares according to a Reuter straw poll of analysts conducted last week. They forecast a price in the range of 3,200 to 3,400, with the 12-month target at about 3,600.
On Friday, Telefonica said it would privatise the remaining 20.94 percent state stake, and that the offering size would be 171 million shares.
